description: This file defines a command handler for closing an SMS campaign within the Fineract platform. It implements the processing of a command to close SMS campaigns by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: CloseSmsCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the command to close an SMS campaign, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to close an SMS campaign by delegating to the smsCampaignWritePlatformService.
